<script>
// Configure localStorage for Optimize experience data
const optimizeStorage = 'wf_optimize_data';
const optimizeTTL = 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes of inactivity

// Initialize Optimize data object from localStorage
const optimizeData = (function() {
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(optimizeStorage);
    if (stored) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
      if (parsed.timestamp && (Date.now() - parsed.timestamp < optimizeTTL)) {
        return parsed.data;
      }
      // Expired — clear it
      localStorage.removeItem(optimizeStorage);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Could not restore Webflow Optimize data from localStorage:', e);
  }
  return {
    experienceId: [],
    experienceName: [],
    experienceType: [],
    variationId: [],
    variationName: [],
    ccStatus: []
  };
})();

// Refresh timestamp on every page load if data exists (rolling expiry)
if (optimizeData.experienceId.length > 0) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(optimizeStorage, JSON.stringify({
      data: optimizeData,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    }));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Could not refresh Optimize data timestamp:', e);
  }
}

// Define getter function for Optimize data
function getOptimizeStrings() {
  // Helper to check if value is meaningful
  function hasValue(val) {
    return val && typeof val === 'string' && val.trim().length > 0;
  }
  
  // Filter out empty entries and format
  const experiments = (optimizeData.experienceName || [])
    .reduce((acc, name, i) => {
      if (hasValue(name) && hasValue(optimizeData.experienceId?.[i])) {
        acc.push(`${name.trim()} (${optimizeData.experienceId[i].trim()})`);
      }
      return acc;
    }, [])
    .join(', ');

  const variants = (optimizeData.variationName || [])
    .reduce((acc, name, i) => {
      if (hasValue(name) && hasValue(optimizeData.variationId?.[i])) {
        acc.push(`${name.trim()} (${optimizeData.variationId[i].trim()})`);
      }
      return acc;
    }, [])
    .join(', ');

  return {
    experiment: experiments,
    variant: variants
  };
};

// Ensure Webflow's API is available before running
if (typeof wf !== 'undefined') {
  wf.ready(() => {
      
    // Listen for Optimize variation assignment
    wf.onVariationRecorded(function(result) {
      try {
        if (result) {

          // Skip if this Optimize experience has already been recorded
          if (result.experienceId && optimizeData.experienceId.includes(result.experienceId)) {
            return;
          }

          optimizeData.experienceId.push(result.experienceId || '');
          optimizeData.experienceName.push(result.experienceName || '');
          optimizeData.experienceType.push(result.experienceType || '');
          optimizeData.variationId.push(result.variationId || '');
          optimizeData.variationName.push(result.variationName || '');
          optimizeData.ccStatus.push(result.ccStatus || '');

          // Persist Optimize experience data across page navigations and new tabs
          try {
            localStorage.setItem(optimizeStorage, JSON.stringify({
              data: optimizeData,
              timestamp: Date.now()
            }));
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Could not save Optimize data to localStorage:', e);
          }

          console.log('Webflow Optimize Experience data: ', optimizeData);

          // Push to any Marketo forms that have already loaded
          if (typeof MktoForms2 !== 'undefined') {
            MktoForms2.whenReady(function(form) {
              var opt = getOptimizeStrings();
              var optFields = {};
              
              // Populate hidden fields with experience data
              if (opt.experiment.length > 0) {
                optFields.Optimization_Experiment__c = opt.experiment;
              }
              if (opt.variant.length > 0) {
                optFields.Optimization_Variant__c = opt.variant;
              }
              if (Object.keys(optFields).length > 0) {
                form.addHiddenFields(optFields);
                console.log('Optimize fields applied to form', form.getId(), ':', optFields);
              } else {
                console.log('No Optimize data available yet for form', form.getId());
              }
            });
          }
        } else {
          console.log('Webflow Optimize experience not found or already recorded');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error parsing Webflow Optimize data:', err);
      }
    });
  });
} else {
  console.warn('Webflow API not available. Optimize experience tracking will not function.');
};
</script>

<script>
async function sha256(message) {
  try {
    if (!window.TextEncoder || !window.crypto?.subtle) return '';
    const msgUint8 = new TextEncoder().encode(message.toLowerCase().trim());
    const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', msgUint8);
    const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
    return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  } catch (e) {
    return '';
  }
}

  // ---- Defensive reads of head-script globals ----------------------------

  // ---- Load with retry ---------------------------------------------------
  function loadWithRetry(wrapper, numericId, attempt) {
    const isFinalAttempt = attempt >= 1;
    const timeoutMs = attempt === 0 ? FIRST_TIMEOUT_MS : RETRY_TIMEOUT_MS;

    // Load lock: a callback from a superseded (or terminally errored) attempt
    // can never touch this wrapper's DOM.

    wrapper._mktoCurrentAttempt = attemptToken;
    wrapper.dataset.mktoState = 'loading';

    const timeoutHandle = setTimeout(function () {
      if (wrapper._mktoCurrentAttempt !== attemptToken) return;

        // later for this same attempt cannot overwrite the error UI. Only a
        // fresh retry click (new token) may load into this wrapper again.
        wrapper._mktoCurrentAttempt = null;
        showError(wrapper, numericId, errorMode());

          return;

        // form, double-register handlers, and eventually show an error over it).
        try {

      clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
      console.error('Error loading Marketo form', numericId, ':', error);
      if (isFinalAttempt) {

        showError(wrapper, numericId, errorMode());

  function initForms() {

    // array would silently match nothing and every shortening form would flicker.
    const rawShortening = Array.isArray(window.shorteningFormIDs) ? window.shorteningFormIDs : [];
    const shorteningSet = new Set(rawShortening.map(Number));
    if (shorteningSet.size === 0) {
      console.warn('shorteningFormIDs unavailable or empty - no forms will be pre-hidden for ZoomInfo shortening.');
    }

    const seen = new Set();

    wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {
      const rawId = (wrapper.id || '').trim();
      const numericId = parseInt(rawId, 10);

      // Forms are business-critical - never fail silently. A markup mistake must
      // be visible on the page, not just in a console nobody reads.
      if (!rawId || !Number.isInteger(numericId) || String(numericId) !== rawId) {
        console.error('Invalid or missing numeric ID for .marketo-wrapper - form will not load:', wrapper);
        showError(wrapper, rawId || 'unknown', 'fatal');

      if (seen.has(numericId)) {
        // Two wrappers with the same id would fight over one form element:
        // one ends up an empty visible box, and handlers register twice.
        console.error('Duplicate .marketo-wrapper id on page - only the first will load:', numericId);
        showError(wrapper, numericId, 'fatal');
        return;
      }
      seen.add(numericId);

      // Only forms explicitly configured for shortening get pre-hidden.
      // Enrich-only forms never depend on ZoomInfo firing.
      if (shorteningSet.has(numericId)) {
        wrapper.classList.add('needs-hide');
        wrapper.style.opacity = '';
      } else {
        wrapper.classList.remove('needs-hide');
        wrapper.style.opacity = '1';

  // overrides an error state, never reveals a wrapper whose form hasn't finished
  // loading (an empty visible box looks broken), and never pre-empts a pending
  // per-wrapper reveal timer (doing so would reveal mid-shortening). Re-checked
  // several times because a form can legitimately still be retrying at ~16s.
  function scheduleHideSafetyNet() {
    SAFETY_NET_CHECKS_MS.forEach(function (delay) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        document.querySelectorAll('.marketo-wrapper.needs-hide').forEach(function (w) {
          if (w._ziRevealTimeout) return;
          if (w.dataset.mktoState === 'loaded' && w.style.opacity !== '1') {
            console.warn('Safety net revealing stuck (but loaded) form wrapper:', w.id);
            w.style.opacity = '1';
          }
        });
      }, delay);
    });
  }

  function attachLegalRowMover() {
    if (typeof MktoForms2 === 'undefined' || typeof MktoForms2.whenRendered !== 'function') return;
    try {
      MktoForms2.whenRendered(function (form) {
        try {
          const formEl = form.getFormElem()[0];
          const moveLegalRow = function () {
            const consentInput = formEl.querySelector('input[name="marketoMarketingConsent"]');
            const legalRow = consentInput ? consentInput.closest('.mktoFormRow') : null;
            const buttonRow = formEl.querySelector('.mktoButtonRow');

              buttonRow.parentNode.insertBefore(legalRow, buttonRow);
              log('Moved legal consent row above submit for form', form.getId());

      console.error('Could not register legal row mover:', e);

  function boot() {
    initForms();
    scheduleHideSafetyNet();
    attachLegalRowMover();
  }

  if (!window.MktoForms2) {
    // forms2.min.js is normally a blocking head script, so reaching here means
    // it was blocked or failed. Try once more, and only run the watchdog on this
    // path - running it unconditionally could flash an error over a page that
    // was merely slow and is about to work.
    let settled = false;
    const scriptTag = document.createElement('script');
    scriptTag.src = '//resources.payscale.com/js/forms2/js/forms2.min.js';
    scriptTag.onload = function () { settled = true; boot(); };
    scriptTag.onerror = function () {
      settled = true;
      console.error('forms2.min.js script tag failed to load (network/blocked).');
      wrappers.forEach(w => showError(w, w.id || 'unknown', 'reload'));
    };
    document.head.appendChild(scriptTag);

    setTimeout(function () {
      if (settled && typeof MktoForms2 !== 'undefined') return;
      console.error('forms2.min.js failed to load/initialize within ' + GLOBAL_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS + 'ms.');
      wrappers.forEach(function (w) {
        if (!w.dataset.mktoState || w.dataset.mktoState === 'loading') {
          showError(w, w.id || 'unknown', 'reload');
        }
      });
    }, GLOBAL_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS);
  } else {
    boot();
  }
  });
})();
